```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("../../../../core/framework/R/framework_init.R")
```

```{r load-gazetteer, include=FALSE}
gaz <- jsonlite::fromJSON("chechnya_ingushetia_settlements.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)

fmt_pop <- function(v) {
  if (is.null(v) || is.na(v)) return("-")
  val <- as.numeric(v)
  if (val >= 1000) {
    paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.1f", val / 1000)), "k")
  } else {
    as.character(round(val))
  }
}

fmt_yr <- function(y) {
  yi <- as.integer(y)
  if (yi < 0) paste0(abs(yi), "BC") else paste0(yi, "AD")
}

get_span <- function(s) {
  yrs <- as.integer(names(s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return("-")
  if (min(yrs) == max(yrs)) return(fmt_yr(min(yrs)))
  paste0(fmt_yr(min(yrs)), " - ", fmt_yr(max(yrs)))
}

get_pop_yr <- function(s, yr) {
  k <- as.character(as.integer(yr))
  if (!is.null(s$population[[k]])) return(fmt_pop(s$population[[k]]))
  return("-")
}

get_pop_window <- function(s, yr_vec) {
  for (y in yr_vec) {
    k <- as.character(as.integer(y))
    if (!is.null(s$population[[k]])) return(fmt_pop(s$population[[k]]))
  }
  return("-")
}

get_peak_str <- function(s) {
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(s$population))
  yrs <- as.integer(names(s$population))
  idx <- which.max(vals)
  paste0(fmt_pop(vals[idx]), " (", fmt_yr(yrs[idx]), ")")
}
```

# Introduction

This supplementary report presents the settlement population gazetteer (`chechnya_ingushetia_settlements.json`) accompanying the regional literature review of Chechnya and Ingushetia (10000BC - 1900AD). The JSON file follows the `population_Stadester` format, indexing `r length(gaz)` settlements across the Chechen Republic and the Republic of Ingushetia by `<Name>-Russia` with alternate and Cyrillic names (`other_names`), decimal coordinates (`coords`), and chronological population estimates (`population`) for inhabited benchmark years.

Prehistoric, Eastern Koban, and Alanic estimates are derived from excavated settlement areas and cemetery studies [@munchaev1961lugovoye; @kozenkova1992serzhen; @vinogradov1970; @chakhkiev2006magas; @mamaev2009]. Highland stone tower and early modern figures draw on architectural surveys of the Assa, Armkhi, and Argun gorges and Russian *Posolskiy Prikaz* records [@markovin1965monuments; @chakhkiev2007weapons; @kusheva1963peoples; @akhmadov2002chechnya; @akhmadov2019chechnya], while 19th-century and 1897 figures come from military registers and the First All-Russian Imperial Census for Terek Oblast [@berger1859chechnya; @ibragimova2006; @troynitskiy1905terek; @kabuzan1996].

# Master Settlement Directory

```{r tab-master, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
df_master <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(gaz, function(s) s$name, character(1)),
  Other_Names = vapply(gaz, function(s) paste(s$other_names, collapse = ", "), character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(gaz, function(s) {
    paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[1]])), "N, ", gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[2]])), "E")
  }, character(1)),
  Span = vapply(gaz, get_span, character(1)),
  Peak = vapply(gaz, get_peak_str, character(1)),
  AD1897 = vapply(gaz, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1897), character(1)),
  AD1900 = vapply(gaz, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1900), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  df_master,
  list(
    caption = "Master directory of all settlements in chechnya_ingushetia_settlements.json (10000BC - 1900AD).",
    label = "tab:chechnya-master-gazetteer",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Historical / Native Names", "Coords", "Documented Span", "Peak Population", "1897AD", "1900AD"),
    alignment = c("l", "l", "l", "l", "r", "r", "r"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)
```

# Prehistoric, Eastern Koban, and Alanic Settlements (10000BC - 1200AD)

```{r tab-prehistoric, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
pre_s <- Filter(function(s) any(as.integer(names(s$population)) <= 1200), gaz)

df_pre <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(pre_s, function(s) s$name, character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(pre_s, function(s) {
    paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[1]])), "N, ", gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[2]])), "E")
  }, character(1)),
  BC_Early = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(-8000, -4000, -3500, -3000, -2500)), character(1)),
  BC1000_500 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(-1500, -1000, -500)), character(1)),
  AD400_600 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(1, 400, 600)), character(1)),
  AD800 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 800), character(1)),
  AD1000 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1000), character(1)),
  AD1200 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1200), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  df_pre,
  list(
    caption = "Prehistoric, Eastern Koban, and Alanic settlement populations in Chechnya and Ingushetia (8000BC - 1200AD).",
    label = "tab:chechnya-prehistoric-alanic",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Coords", "8000-2500BC", "1500-500BC", "1-600AD", "800AD", "1000AD", "1200AD"),
    alignment = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)
```

# Late Medieval Highland Tower Complexes and Early Modern Settlements (1300 - 1700AD)

```{r tab-medieval, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
med_s <- Filter(function(s) {
  yrs <- as.integer(names(s$population))
  any(yrs >= 1300 & yrs <= 1700)
}, gaz)

df_med <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(med_s, function(s) s$name, character(1)),
  Other_Names = vapply(med_s, function(s) paste(s$other_names, collapse = ", "), character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(med_s, function(s) {
    paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[1]])), "N, ", gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[2]])), "E")
  }, character(1)),
  AD1400 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(1300, 1400)), character(1)),
  AD1600 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(1500, 1600)), character(1)),
  AD1700 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1700), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  df_med,
  list(
    caption = "Highland stone tower complexes and early modern settlements in Chechnya and Ingushetia (1300 - 1700AD).",
    label = "tab:chechnya-medieval-towers",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Historical / Native Names", "Coords", "1300/1400AD", "1500/1600AD", "1700AD"),
    alignment = c("l", "l", "l", "r", "r", "r"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)
```

# Eighteenth and Nineteenth-Century Settlements (1700 - 1900AD)

```{r tab-modern, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
mod_s <- Filter(function(s) any(as.integer(names(s$population)) >= 1700), gaz)

df_mod <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(mod_s, function(s) s$name, character(1)),
  Other_Names = vapply(mod_s, function(s) paste(s$other_names, collapse = ", "), character(1)),
  AD1700 = vapply(mod_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1700), character(1)),
  AD1750 = vapply(mod_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(1725, 1750, 1770, 1780)), character(1)),
  AD1800 = vapply(mod_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1800), character(1)),
  AD1850 = vapply(mod_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1850), character(1)),
  AD1897 = vapply(mod_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1897), character(1)),
  AD1900 = vapply(mod_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1900), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  df_mod,
  list(
    caption = "Eighteenth and nineteenth-century settlement populations in Chechnya and Ingushetia (1700 - 1900AD).",
    label = "tab:chechnya-modern-settlements",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Historical / Native Names", "1700AD", "1750AD", "1800AD", "1850AD", "1897AD", "1900AD"),
    alignment = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)
```
